messages:
Amir: Quick follow-up — I noticed the React sample that uses our browser-sdk shows repeated tokens after an auth refresh during long streams. Happens on Chrome + Firefox in staging behind our corporate proxy.
Tess: Thanks — can you repro locally or have logs? Which SDK + version?
Amir: browser-sdk v1.9. Using native EventSource. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-22T11:02:10Z] stream.start id=stream-55
[2026-03-22T11:03:15Z] auth.warn token_expire=soon
[2026-03-22T11:03:16Z] auth.401 during stream
[2026-03-22T11:03:16Z] client.reconnect attempting soft-refresh
[2026-03-22T11:03:16Z] event.recv data:"{\"delta\": \"Thi"
[2026-03-22T11:03:16Z] event.recv data:"s is a test\"}\n"
[2026-03-22T11:03:16Z] ui.append "This is a testThis is a test"
```
Amir: UI shows the phrase twice.
Tess: Two potential causes: (1) Server re-sent the last window because we didn't include Last-Event-ID on reconnect; (2) The client reassembled fragments incorrectly and emitted the completed event twice (polyfilled or wrapper bug).
Amir: I instrumented last_received_id and found server sent event id 102 then 103 after reconnect; but client rendered 102 twice. So client-side duping seems plausible.
eng-bot: CI: sample-ui/staging sse-e2e-tests queued.
Tess: Ok, here's an investigative checklist I recommend: 
- Confirm whether reconnect includes Last-Event-ID header.
- Confirm wrapper dedup logic: ignore events with id <= last_seen_id.
- Make parser tolerant: accumulate chunks until SSE event boundary (\n\n) before trying to parse.
- Handle CR-only or mixed CRLF boundaries (proxy weirdness).
- On auth 401, try soft-refresh (get new token) and then reconnect with Last-Event-ID; avoid full stream tear-down unless necessary.
Amir: I tried buffering until full event terminator and it fixed parse exceptions but duplicates still happen. I can share a tiny mitmproxy script that splits chunks unpredictably.
Tess: Good. Let's add a small de-dupe cache in browser-sdk keyed by event id with TTL=30s as a safety net. Also verify event IDs are monotonic. If not, we should design a compound id (stream-id + seq).
Support: From an onboarding perspective, add a subsection to the SSE quickstart: "Long-lived streams and auth" with an example of Last-Event-ID usage and a soft-refresh pattern. Many customers start with naive EventSource examples and hit this.
Amir: I'll open an issue in sample-ui and paste the mitmproxy script. Tess, can you take SDK PR for de-dupe + buffering?
Tess: Yup. Will include unit tests that replay split-chunk event sequences (CR, LF, CRLF mixes). Will also ensure reconnect sets Last-Event-ID when recovering from auth 401.
Amir: One extra note — when reconnect occurs mid-multiline SSE event (multiple data: lines), server may re-send from first data: line of the event. Our parser must treat the whole event as atomic for dedupe.
Tess: Good catch. We'll ensure dedupe uses event-id, not data payload hash.
eng-bot: PR created: sdk/browser #987 "sse: buffer + id de-dupe + last-event-id on reconnect". CI running.
Support: I'll update docs and add a short troubleshooting snippet for duplicated tokens.
Amir: Thanks all. If anyone wants the repro harness ping me and I'll drop it in the ticket. :thumbsup:
